messages:
Maria Ortiz: Heads up — vendor just sent an urgent note: they're requesting a swap/rollback for 12 H100s allocated to APAC due to a batch firmware/serial mismatch discovered at staging. Asking us to hold any provisioning until they confirm replacements. :exclamation:
Ben Kline (vendor): sorry for the noise — we found 12 units with mismatched firmware (log mismatch on boot). Our ops team proposes either overnight air replacement or a swap with OEM-refurb H100s this week. We can cover expedited freight but customs risk remains. ETA options: 48h (air, partial AWB), 7d (sea + consolidated docs).
Maria Ortiz: @Ben Kline (vendor) can you confirm if those replacements come with full warranty and if the serials will map to same SKUs for our provisioning automation? we need a firm ETA — APAC clusters are at ~78% capacity tonight. :eyes:
Ben Kline (vendor): warranty will be standard OEM warranty. Serial mapping: replacements will have new serials, we'll provide a manifest and reconcile. I'll attach AWB and manifest as soon as the shipping team confirms.
Chao Li: tagging logistics — when you have AWB manifest include HS code and value per unit. Customs in SG/PVG is sensitive this week (holidays). We should avoid split shipments unless necessary. Suggest consolidate to single AWB if air.
Sarah Patel: from infra side — if we hold these 12 units offline we need a short mitigation plan. Options: 1) shift canary capacity to US-e and defer non-critical pipelines, 2) borrow 8 loaner GPUs from our on-site pool (1-week loaners), 3) throttle batch jobs via autoscaler tweaks. Which is least disruptive?
Maria Ortiz: preference is option 2 + 3. Chao — can you confirm loaner availability and turn-around for redeploy? Sarah — can you draft the autoscaler throttle we can flip? keep latency-sensitive routes intact.
Chao Li: loaner pool shows 6 GPUs free in SIN and 4 in PVG. We can stage 6 immediately, remaining 2 need 24h prep. Will coordinate pickup and paperwork. AWB will be generated by vendor for replacements; for loaners we'll use internal transfer POs.
RMA Bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-2026-1729. Current status: vendor-initiated. Assigned to Ben Kline (vendor). Expected action: manifest + AWB upload within 6h.
Ben Kline (vendor): uploaded preliminary manifest to the shared drive: https://redwood.shares/drive/manifest-2645 (contains temp AWB placeholders). We'll confirm air vs sea by EOD after customs check.
Sarah Patel: infra action items — I will: 1) add a temporary label to those serial ranges so provisioning skips them, 2) add an autoscaler policy to reduce batch replica target from 80 -> 50 for APAC, 3) open a canary redirect to US-e for low-latency fallbacks. ETA for changes: 90 min.
Maria Ortiz: thanks. Also need a decision on cost: if vendor chooses sea (7d), do they still cover expedited credits for production impact? we should get a written credit/penalty for SLA miss.
Ben Kline (vendor): we can provide a 20% credit on the affected units if sea delays beyond 72h, or we can pay for air charges. I'll escalate for written confirmation.
Chao Li: logistics note — customs paperwork will need power specs and invoice value per unit. Ben, please include HS code 8471.80 and agreed unit value. Split shipments increase brokerage risk and hold times.
Maria Ortiz: agreed — do not split unless unavoidable. Also, please push a short RCA explaining root cause (firmware mismatch path) and action items to prevent recurrence. We'll need it for postmortem and finance.
Ben Kline (vendor): under way. I'll post RCA draft when shipping ops completes their checklist.
RMA Bot: update: RMA-2026-1729 status -> manifest_received. Next: customs_check_in_progress.
Sarah Patel: small ops ask — please provide a quick command we can run to take identified serials offline in our inventory system. sample: ```/infra/mark_offline --serial S/N-APAC-XXXXX --node gpu-node-7```
Chao Li: noted. I'll handle transfer docs for loaners and coordinate courier ETA once Ben confirms AWB.
Maria Ortiz: plan summary: hold replacements, stage 6 loaners from SIN, throttle batch autoscaler, require vendor written credit terms if sea chosen, RCA to be submitted, RMA ticket tracked. Next check-in in 4h. :thumbsup:
Ben Kline (vendor): copy — I aim to confirm shipping modality and credit terms within 4h. Apologies again, we'll make this right.
Sarah Patel: marking action items in the incident board.
Maria Ortiz: thanks everyone. Tagging finance & legal internally to review credit language after Ben posts it. :white_check_mark:
